description.value: Hazelmere Pumpkin Patch is a multi-generational family farm in South Surrey's Hazelmere Valley, operated by Gabriel Farms Ltd. since 2001 on land the Gabriel family has farmed since the 1930s. The 20-acre farm grows 12+ acres of pumpkins and gourds and features a mini corn maze, farm animal interaction areas, and play zones during its fall harvest season. Year-round, the farm also offers educational programs, school tours, spring break camps, and summer farm camps for children.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an actively operating seasonal farm attraction (entering its 26th pumpkin patch season, 2026 opening weekend Sept 19/20), run by Gabriel Farms Ltd. in South Surrey's Hazelmere Valley. The website corroborates the OSM phone number (604-542-1205) and pumpkin patch address (18507 20th Ave.), but the contact page lists a separate mailing address (1958 184th St Surrey BC V3Z9V2) that uses the same postcode as the OSM record, creating ambiguity about which address the postcode belongs to. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water access, or any other cyclist-facing infrastructure — are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag ('Nov-Dec, Jan-Aug off') is inconsistent with the website, which shows the pumpkin patch opening weekend as September 19/20 — the primary season is fall (Sept–Oct), not Nov–Dec.

The contact page lists two distinct addresses: pumpkin patch at '18507 20th Ave. Surrey BC' and a separate mailing address at '1958 184th St Surrey BC V3Z9V2'. The postcode V3Z9V2 in the OSM record appears alongside the mailing address on the website, not the pumpkin patch address, creating uncertainty about whether the OSM address record is correctly composed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate and active seasonal farm attraction that could interest fall cycling day-trippers in the Lower Mainland, but no cycling-specific amenities are confirmed from the website, the OSM opening_hours tag appears inaccurate, and the postcode in the OSM address record may belong to the farm's mailing address rather than the pumpkin patch site.
